title: SEC0: Contacts list column alignment overflows with long values
description:
main.rs:106-123 (cmd_contacts_list) uses fixed-width format specs ({:<30}, {:<25}, {:<40}) but does NOT truncate values that exceed the column width.

Example failures:
1. login > 30 chars: expands LOGIN column, pushes DISPLAY NAME column rightward
2. display_name > 25 chars: breaks MAILBOX HOST alignment
3. mailbox_host > 40 chars: overflows into BLOCKED column

Result: Table becomes misaligned and hard to read, especially with many long contact names.

Fix: Use itertools::Itertools::pad_str or manually truncate each field before formatting. Apply consistent max-width constraints and append ellipsis (...) to truncated values, similar to how watch.rs:25 truncates message bodies.
